meta.title: Direct FFI Integration for idb_companion
meta.body_summary: Introduce Direct FFI integration as a lightweight alternative to gRPC, claiming 500x faster latency and 40x smaller binary size; includes Objective‑C interfaces, Rust FFI bindings, an extensive FBProcess→FBIDBProcess rename, CI workflows, and a Rust calibration client.

perf_labels.notes: Claude Code generated large FFI integration PR with performance claims but no benchmark; closed immediately after CLA bot request; no review engagement.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 5177 changed lines across 107 files, this is a very large change by absolute volume. It includes a new Direct FFI integration, extensive renames across multiple modules, CI workflow changes, and a Rust client addition. As a large‑scale architectural change from a fork, it was closed without merge, likely due to procedural gates (CLA not signed) and lack of maintainer interest in such a broad contribution.

review_details.concern_detail: The only comment is from facebook-github-bot requiring CLA signing; no technical review occurred. The PR was closed approximately one minute after creation.
review_details.performance_claim: 500x faster than gRPC (microseconds vs milliseconds), 40x smaller binary (~500KB vs ~20MB), zero dependencies.
review_details.rejection_signals: Procedural close: CLA bot requested signature; PR closed ~1 minute after creation.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Large cross‑language refactor from a fork faces process barriers (CLA, maintainer reluctance) that prevent any technical evaluation.

detection_detail.code_reading: No maintainer review or detection occurred.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after data provided; only narrative claims of speedup and size reduction.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without any fix cycle, likely due to CLA not being signed.

core_change_summary.description: Adds a Direct FFI layer (idb_direct.h/m etc.) to bypass gRPC, a Rust FFI binding, extensive FBProcess→FBIDBProcess rename across many files, CI workflow changes, and a Rust gRPC calibration client. The performance claim is that FFI provides microsecond latency vs millisecond gRPC.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Massive rename of internal classes across many directories; CI pipeline additions for release and signing.
change_trajectory: Added fork documentation and GitHub Actions workflows.
Configured ARM64‑only builds, code signing, and notarization.
Performed extensive FBProcess→FBIDBProcess rename across dozens of files, with follow‑up fixes for missed references.
Added Rust gRPC client for simulator calibration testing.
Final commit: Implemented Direct FFI integration with C/Objective‑C interfaces, Rust bindings, and detailed documentation.

review_signals.summary: Bot requested CLA signing as a merge requirement.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with 27 commits from Claude Code, covering a very large scope.
PR closed ~1 minute later without any human review or code interaction.
